title: The Eken: Kerela - e Kurukshetra Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for The Eken: Kerela - e Kurukshetra — Eken Babu’s Kerala case releases October 15.
body:
• The trailer for The Eken: Kerela - e Kurukshetra dropped October 07, 2026.
  • Eken Babu heads to Kerala for his newest case — and can’t tell whether he’s been kidnapped or invited.
  • Releasing October 15, 2026, right in the Durga Puja window.

SVF and hoichoi studios have released the official trailer for The Eken: Kerela - e Kurukshetra, unveiled October 07, 2026. Anirban Chakrabarti returns as the beloved bumbling detective Eken Babu, joined as always by Suhotra Mukhopadhyay as Bapi and Somak Ghosh as Promotho, with Ritwick Chakraborty and Raima Sen joining the ensemble this time.

https://x.com/SVFsocial/status/2107449060949156204

The mystery centers on the disappearance of a high-profile man, Mihir Sen (Kamaleswar Mukherjee), which pulls Eken out of his comfort zone and into Kerala — a trip where the first puzzle is whether he has been summoned or abducted. Directed by Joydeep Mukherjee from the late Sujan Dasgupta’s story, the film is one of the marquee Durga Puja 2026 releases.

That matters: the Eken Babu franchise is one of West Bengal’s biggest theatrical properties, and its previous entry, The Eken: Benaras e Bibhishika (May 2025), became the highest-grossing film in the franchise’s theatrical run. Taking the fish-out-of-water detective to Kerala for the first time is the franchise’s biggest swing yet.
